notes: Behaviour matches the brief: only rows whose hard no's are all waivable get stamped, judged on the same merged fit_input the Fit uses; fetch batched in chunks of DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SYMBOLS (50); evaluate on completed bars capped at min(now, close), fires kept from the session open on; a failed fetch, short tape or bad tape leaves None and never raises; runner stamps immediately before apply_trader_fit_ranking. All 16 hidden failures are interface differences the brief never named (stamp_m30_extended_pullbacks, no evaluate_extended_pullback, target_session returns (opened, closed) datetimes instead of (date, evaluate_at)). Small fixes: naive datetime.now() instead of market_session.get_market_local_now(); fetch-failure warning once per chunk; session-None branch logs nothing. Tests strong (real QDEL tape and calendar; fire today, fire yesterday, short tape, failed fetch, malformed tape, non-extended rows, chunks of 50, clock); no short-side case. Renaming _fit_inputs is avoidable churn. No self-review (turn cap). Ranking and tagging only, fails closed to a hard no; no order/sizing code.
lead_note: Judge was given the lead note on the rework, the measured test results, the hidden-test causes and the pre-existing trader_fit/setup_tagging code.
